observations: Photos show a black PlayStation console (no controller shown).
Photo 0 and 1 show the front/top with a PlayStation logo and watermark text; no visible model label.
Photo 2 shows the back with ports/buttons visible; no visible model number/variant.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4 – letting you experience incredible image...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic marketing; photos do not show a PS4 Pro model identifier.

risks.risk: Console model/variant is not confirmed from photos (could be PS4 Slim/Fat or another PlayStation).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/sticker showing the exact model (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and region, plus a photo of the front model/side markings if any.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest matching PS4 type in the comparables (worst case: not PS4 Pro).

risks.risk: No proof of working status (no power-on, no game/menu screen, no controller shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip powering on to the home screen and showing the disc drive/USB ports working (and controller connected if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/assume basic functionality only; do not pay PS4 Pro premium.

risks.risk: Hacked/modified status and storage capacity are not shown; could affect value and reliability.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of system settings → storage and system information (or a video showing the settings screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming extra value from hacking or larger storage.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness is unclear (seller text mentions only console conceptually; photos show only the console).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything included laid out (controller(s), cables, HDMI, power cable, games).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only (worst case for missing controller/cables).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the console’s sticker/label with the exact model code (CUH-xxxx) and region.
Send a short video powering on to the PS home screen (and show the controller connected if included).
Send photos of included items (controller(s), HDMI, power cable, any games).
Send a photo/video of System Settings → Storage/System Information.
response.reason: The photos show a generic PlayStation console but do not confirm it is a PS4 Pro, nor do they prove working status or included accessories—so a worst-case price cannot be set confidently from the provided evidence.
